---
name: "Feature Request"
about: Suggest an idea or improvement for this project.
title: '[Feature]: '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature description
A clear and concise description of what the feature should do.

## 💡 Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Describe the ideal user flow and the value it adds.

## 🔄 Alternative Solutions / Workarounds
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, tools, or manual workarounds you've considered.

## 🛠️ Additional Context
Add any other context, sketches, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.

## 📊 Priority / Urgency
*Please check the box that best describes the importance of this feature for you:*
- [ ] **Nice to have** (Would be cool, but no rush)
- [ ] **Important** (Adds significant value to the daily workflow)
- [ ] **Critical** (Blocks important work without this feature)
